label: 门
description: 追加 door_frame(...) + door_leaf(...) 两条 shape：门框 + 独立门扇。当 prompt 提到 门 / 门扇 / 门框 / door 时使用。摆放契约：门框以「所在墙」part 为父（g_joint_fixed），origin=[x,0,0]，x 取自该墙 openings 那一项；门扇**不要与门框同心**，须放到本电池返回的 leaf_origin/leaf_origins（门扇局部原点在铰链边），可以门框 part 为父。**默认全用 g_joint_fixed 连门扇（推荐）**：低模建筑通常不需要真会开的门。⚠️ 一旦用 g_joint_revolute 做可开门，g_geometry_qc 会把**全楼**的 AABB 交叠（墙角/嵌框/楼梯井等低模常态交叠）**整体升级为致命**——这就是「窗没问题、门却过不了 QC」的头号原因；此时必须在 g_geometry_qc 用 allow_pairs 白名单掉这些合理交叠对（如 "door1:wall_s"、"door1:door1_leaf"）。
description-en: Append `door_frame(...)` + `door_leaf(...)` — frame plus a separate leaf shape. Use for door. Placement contract: parent the frame to its host WALL part (g_joint_fixed) with origin=[x,0,0] from that wall's `openings` entry; do NOT place the leaf concentric with the frame — put it at the returned leaf_origin/leaf_origins (the leaf's local origin is at the hinge edge), parented to the frame part. **Default to g_joint_fixed for the leaf (recommended)**: static low-poly buildings rarely need a truly swinging door. ⚠️ The moment you join a leaf with g_joint_revolute, g_geometry_qc promotes EVERY AABB overlap in the whole model (benign wall-corner / embedded-frame / stair-well overlaps) to FATAL — this is the #1 reason a door fails QC while windows pass; then you MUST whitelist the benign pairs via g_geometry_qc allow_pairs (e.g. "door1:wall_s", "door1:door1_leaf").

inputs.description: left / right：门扇转轴落在哪侧（单扇）
inputs.description-en: left / right: which side carries the hinge axis (single leaf).

inputs.name: transom

inputs.description: 门头亮子高度（在门扇上方加横挺，米）；0=无
inputs.description-en: Transom light height above the leaf; 0 = none.

inputs.name: sidelight
inputs.label: 侧窗宽
inputs.description: 每侧侧窗宽度（在门洞两侧加竖挺，米）；0=无

inputs.name: openable
inputs.label: 可开
inputs.description: 提示生成器用 revolute（可开）而非 fixed（静态）连接门扇。默认 false：低模建筑通常用 fixed；设 true 前先读上面的 QC 警告（可开门会让全楼交叠判致命，需 allow_pairs 白名单）
inputs.description-en: Hint the generator to join the leaf revolute (openable) vs fixed. Default false: static low-poly buildings usually use fixed; before setting true, read the QC warning above (an openable door makes QC promote every building overlap to fatal, needs allow_pairs).

inputs.description: 门框 id；空 = 自动 door{n}；门扇 id = <id>_leaf
inputs.description-en: Frame id; empty = auto door{n}; leaf id = <id>_leaf.
